<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Dialog as ShardsDialog } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
  export type CommandDialogBackdropProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsDialog.Backdrop>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
  let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: CommandDialogBackdropProps = $props();
</script>

<DialogPrimitive.Backdrop
  bind:ref
  class={cn(
    "fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/32 backdrop-blur-sm transition-all duration-200 data-ending-style:opacity-0 data-starting-style:opacity-0",
    className,
  )}
  data-slot="command-dialog-backdrop"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Dialog as ShardsDialog } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
  export type CommandDialogPopupProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsDialog.Popup> & {
    portalProps?: ComponentProps<typeof ShardsDialog.Portal>;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as D } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
  import Backdrop from "./command-dialog-backdrop.svelte";
  import Viewport from "./command-dialog-viewport.svelte";
  let {
    children: child,
    class: className,
    portalProps = {},
    ref = $bindable(null),
    ...props
  }: CommandDialogPopupProps = $props();
</script>

<D.Portal {...portalProps}
  ><Backdrop />
  <Viewport
    ><D.Popup
      bind:ref
      class={cn(
        "relative row-start-2 flex max-h-105 min-h-0 w-full min-w-0 max-w-xl -translate-y-[calc(1.25rem*var(--nested-dialogs))] scale-[calc(1-0.1*var(--nested-dialogs))] flex-col rounded-2xl border bg-popover not-dark:bg-clip-padding text-popover-foreground opacity-[calc(1-0.1*var(--nested-dialogs))] shadow-lg/5 outline-none transition-[scale,opacity,translate] duration-200 ease-in-out will-change-transform before:pointer-events-none before:absolute before:inset-0 before:rounded-[calc(var(--radius-2xl)-1px)] before:bg-muted/72 before:shadow-[0_1px_--theme(--color-black/4%)] data-nested:data-ending-style:translate-y-8 data-nested:data-starting-style:translate-y-8 data-nested-dialog-open:origin-top data-ending-style:scale-98 data-starting-style:scale-98 data-ending-style:opacity-0 data-starting-style:opacity-0 **:data-[slot=scroll-area-viewport]:data-has-overflow-y:pe-1 dark:before:shadow-[0_-1px_--theme(--color-white/6%)]",
        className,
      )}
      data-slot="command-dialog-popup"
      {...props}
      >{#snippet children(state)}
        {@render child?.(state)}
      {/snippet}</D.Popup
    ></Viewport
  ></D.Portal
>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Dialog as ShardsDialog } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
  export type CommandDialogTriggerProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsDialog.Trigger>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as D } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  let { ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: CommandDialogTriggerProps = $props();
</script>

<D.Trigger bind:ref data-slot="command-dialog-trigger" {...props} />

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Dialog as ShardsDialog } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
  export type CommandDialogViewportProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsDialog.Viewport>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
  let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: CommandDialogViewportProps = $props();
</script>

<DialogPrimitive.Viewport
  bind:ref
  class={cn(
    "fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-[max(--spacing(4),4vh)] sm:py-[10vh]",
    className,
  )}
  data-slot="command-dialog-viewport"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Autocomplete as ShardsAutocomplete } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
  export type CommandEmptyProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAutocomplete.Empty>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Autocomplete as A } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
  let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: CommandEmptyProps = $props();
</script>

<A.Empty
  bind:ref
  class={cn(
    "not-empty:p-2 text-center text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-sm not-empty:py-6",
    className,
  )}
  data-slot="command-empty"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { CommandPartProps } from "./command-part.svelte";
  export type CommandFooterProps = CommandPartProps;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Part from "./command-part.svelte";
  let { ...props }: CommandFooterProps = $props();
</script>

<Part
  baseClass="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-b-[calc(var(--radius-2xl)-1px)] border-t px-5 py-3 text-muted-foreground text-xs"
  dataSlot="command-footer"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Autocomplete as ShardsAutocomplete } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

  export type CommandGroupLabelProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAutocomplete.GroupLabel>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Autocomplete as A } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

  let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: CommandGroupLabelProps = $props();
</script>

<A.GroupLabel
  bind:ref
  class={cn("px-2 py-1.5 font-medium text-muted-foreground text-xs", className)}
  data-slot="command-group-label"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Autocomplete as ShardsAutocomplete } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

  export type CommandGroupProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAutocomplete.Group>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Autocomplete as A } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

  let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: CommandGroupProps = $props();
</script>

<A.Group
  bind:ref
  class={cn("[[role=group]+&]:mt-1.5", className)}
  data-slot="command-group"
  {...props}
/>
{#snippet searchIcon()} {/snippet}

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Autocomplete as ShardsAutocomplete } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
  export type CommandItemProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAutocomplete.Item>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Autocomplete as A } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
  let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: CommandItemProps = $props();
</script>

<A.Item
  bind:ref
  class={cn(
    "flex min-h-8 cursor-default select-none items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-base outline-none data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-highlighted:bg-accent data-highlighted:text-accent-foreground data-disabled:opacity-64 sm:min-h-7 sm:text-sm py-1.5",
    className,
  )}
  data-slot="command-item"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { AutocompleteListProps } from "../autocomplete/autocomplete-list.svelte";
  export type CommandListProps = AutocompleteListProps;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
  import List from "../autocomplete/autocomplete-list.svelte";
  let { class: className, ...props }: CommandListProps = $props();
</script>

<List
  class={cn("not-empty:scroll-py-2 not-empty:p-2", className)}
  data-slot="command-list"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { CommandPartProps } from "./command-part.svelte";
  export type CommandPanelProps = CommandPartProps;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Part from "./command-part.svelte";
  let { ...props }: CommandPanelProps = $props();
</script>

<Part
  baseClass="relative -mx-px not-has-[+[data-slot=command-footer]]:-mb-px min-h-0 rounded-t-xl not-has-[+[data-slot=command-footer]]:rounded-b-2xl border border-b-0 bg-popover bg-clip-padding shadow-xs/5 [clip-path:inset(0_1px)] not-has-[+[data-slot=command-footer]]:[clip-path:inset(0_1px_1px_1px_round_0_0_calc(var(--radius-2xl)-1px)_calc(var(--radius-2xl)-1px))] before:pointer-events-none before:absolute before:inset-0 before:rounded-t-[calc(var(--radius-xl)-1px)] **:data-[slot=scroll-area-scrollbar]:mt-2"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
  export type CommandPartProps = Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "class"> & {
    as?: "div" | "kbd";
    children?: Snippet;
    class?: string | null;
    ref?: HTMLElement | null;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
  let {
    as = "div",
    baseClass,
    children,
    class: className,
    dataSlot,
    ref = $bindable(null),
    ...props
  }: CommandPartProps & { baseClass: string; dataSlot?: string } = $props();
</script>

<svelte:element
  this={as}
  bind:this={ref}
  class={cn(baseClass, className)}
  data-slot={dataSlot}
  {...props}>{@render children?.()}</svelte:element
>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Autocomplete as ShardsAutocomplete } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
  export type CommandRootProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAutocomplete.Root>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Autocomplete as A } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  let {
    autoHighlight = "always",
    children,
    inline = true,
    keepHighlight = true,
    open = true,
    ...props
  }: CommandRootProps = $props();
</script>

<A.Root {autoHighlight} {inline} {keepHighlight} {open} {...props}>{@render children?.()}</A.Root>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { Autocomplete as ShardsAutocomplete } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
  export type CommandSeparatorProps = ComponentProps<typeof ShardsAutocomplete.Separator>;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Autocomplete as A } from "@shardsui/svelte";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
  let { class: className, ref = $bindable(null), ...props }: CommandSeparatorProps = $props();
</script>

<A.Separator
  bind:ref
  class={cn("mx-2 h-px bg-border last:hidden my-2", className)}
  data-slot="command-separator"
  {...props}
/>

<script module lang="ts">
  import type { CommandPartProps } from "./command-part.svelte";
  export type CommandShortcutProps = CommandPartProps;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Part from "./command-part.svelte";
  let { ...props }: CommandShortcutProps = $props();
</script>

<Part
  as="kbd"
  baseClass="ms-auto font-medium font-sans text-muted-foreground/72 text-xs tracking-widest"
  dataSlot="command-shortcut"
  {...props}
/>
